prompt: Sum each row of a 2D array. Complete the rowSums method so it returns a new array holding the sum of every row, even when rows have different lengths.
explanation: The result array has one slot per row, so it is created with length grid.length. A nested loop visits each row and adds up its values with an accumulator that resets to 0 for every row. Because the inner loop uses grid[row].length, jagged rows and empty rows are handled automatically, and an empty grid simply produces an empty result.
hints: Create the result with new int[grid.length] -- one slot per row.
Use an outer loop over rows and an inner loop over grid[row], which may have a different length for each row.
Reset your running total to 0 at the start of each row before adding that row's values.
